Sandbox_GunsOfTien_RealisticPiercing_too: Plain (full metal jacket) .30-06, 7.62x51mm and .308 rounds can pass through a zombie and hit the one behind it in every gun that fires them, as they would in reality. Guns of Marz lets only some of those guns pierce. Soft points never pierce but hit harder, so choosing between them is always a trade-off. Plain .30-30 rounds are flat-nosed soft points in reality (pointed bullets are unsafe in a tube magazine), so they no longer pierce. Off = Guns of Marz's own piercing.
Sandbox_GunsOfTien_SubsonicRackRule_tool: The Soviet US subsonic round burns too little powder to work an AK's gas system, so the gun has to be racked by hand after every shot. A PBS-1 suppressor traps gas and raises the pressure in the barrel, which pushes enough gas into the gas port to cycle the gun. The round and the suppressor were made as a pair.
Sandbox_GunsOfTien_SubsonicRackRule_opti: Rack unless a PBS-1 is fitted
Sandbox_GunsOfTien_RescaleGuns_tooltip: Draws Guns of Marz's guns in proportion to the character and to each other, on the M16A2's scale. Guns that take the same magazines are drawn the same size. Not resized: MP5K Submachine Gun, Stolzer & Son of Kansas 2-Bore Rifle. A change takes effect after a restart.
